pt:drop.documentation: The value is never persisted: no column, no insert parameter, no log field, no expanded attribute.

pt:local-log.documentation: The value stays in the caller's CSV log only, never in the store or an expanded document. Safe only while the log stays local.

pt:ext-ref.documentation: An external system's identifier, that system (an ERP, an HR system, an identity realm) being the system of record, where the value is resolved and erased: a system prefix and an identifier with no spaces, e.g. hr:person/4711. The check recognises a clear value by its shape, not its meaning; an application is expected to override it with its system's exact form.

pt:inline-refs.documentation: Free text in which people appear only as references ⟨person <ext-ref>⟩. The check makes sure every reference is well-formed; it can't prove the text around them names nobody.

pt:keyed-hash.documentation: An HMAC-SHA256 with a tenant key, in hex, prefixed by the key's identifier, where no system of record exists. Destroying the key erases the whole tenant.
